performance.verdict: CPL efficiency is real, but volume collapse and 3 overdue milestones threaten August prove-it month.

findings.text: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) are overdue; 81 GHL opps created but 0 won and 0 appointments recorded — attribution is blind.
Renewal closed 2026-07-23 milestone unresolved; August is a prove-it month and scoreboard (leads → schedules → shows → patients) has no confirmed pipeline data in GHL to verify.
CPL improved 26% 7d vs prior 7d to ~$11.90 (28d avg), but spend fell 32.93% and leads fell 9.37% — efficiency gain is budget-driven contraction, not true optimization; volume risk is high.
3-day signal (Aug 15–17): spend averaged $31.49/day vs $63.59/day prior 3 days (Aug 12–14); leads dropped to 4 total vs 15 — a confirmed deceleration inside an already-compressed spend curve.
GBP logged 0 actions on Aug 15–17 after averaging 11/day Aug 8–14; SC clicks also 0 on Aug 15 and 17 — organic signals went quiet in same window as paid pullback, compounding volume risk.

suggestions.text: Escalate phone-match attribution and GHL contact cleanup immediately; 0 won opps from 81 makes August scoreboard unmeasurable.
